title: Triple factor map minus two
plain: Map n to P(n) + P(n+1) + P(n+2) − 2. Tested starts reach the fixed points 8 or 33, a 13-step loop through 20, or a 9-step loop through 177. Prove nothing else happens.
math: For $f(n)=P(n)+P(n+1)+P(n+2)-2$, prove every orbit reaches $\{8\}$, $\{33\}$, the 13-cycle through $20$, or the 9-cycle through $177$.
